doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Preferred music: Dixieland
summary: Bailey loves Dixieland and dislikes rock and roll; McNeil likes sentimental music and Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: What kind of music do you prefer most of all to play yourself? Myself?
Dixieland. Best music in the world, man. That rock and roll music song is rock.
Yeah. I like sort of sentimental music. You like sentimental? More or less, yeah. That's good too. Personal preference. That's good too. But I like the Dixieland style of jazz and so on.
